scope: 48 fixed independent developer-labelled ordinary requests plus 12 separately reported boundary probes. Strict intent=mode and action multiset, not semantic equivalence or population accuracy.

paired.scope: Same HTTP output replayed through real source/schema/typed compiler; baseline emits raw proposal without those guards. Neither arm calls bank tools; no unsafe payment baseline. Wrong intent labels are separate from wrong money parameter evidence.

transfer_scope: 12 instantaneous domestic CNY journeys; 2 fixed multi-turn sequences. Scheduled, AA and FX completion not included. First-pass denominator includes outages; service-available subset shown separately.
parameter_boundary: 18条普通样本中37个预标注字段；未覆盖所有输出字段及额外字段错误。
